bundle.shortDescription: Research papers, presentations and interactive stories — local LaTeX studio
bundle.longDescription: Quantum Maze is a local-first desktop studio for writing and compiling research papers in LaTeX, building Beamer presentations (with PowerPoint export) and creating interactive scroll-driven web stories.
